name: TS Hotspot Quiz
author: rktaiwala

sections.description:
TS Hotspot Quiz transforms boring multiple-choice tests into engaging, interactive visual challenges. Instead of asking students to select an answer, make them point to it.

Built specifically for medical students (anatomy), geography teachers (maps), and technical trainers (diagrams), this plugin allows you to create “Match the Following” style quizzes directly on top of any image.

🚀 Free Features (Included)

  • Connect Mode: Students drag a line from a term (e.g., “Left Ventricle”) to the correct hotspot on the image.
  • Visual Builder: Easy-to-use backend editor. Just upload an image and click to set hotspots.
  • Instant Feedback: Students see immediate pass/fail results with a scoring breakdown.
  • Responsive: Works perfectly on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.
  • Shortcode Embed: Place your visual quiz on any page, post, or lesson using [ts_visual_quiz id="123"].
  • Unlimited Quizzes: Create as many visual assessments as you need.

🏆 Pro Features (Upgrade)

Upgrade to TS Hotspot Quiz Pro for advanced assessment capabilities:

  • 🖊️ Draw Mode: Students must draw the actual path/line with their mouse or finger (perfect for tracing nerves or rivers).
  • ⌨️ Type Mode: No word bank! Students must type the correct label for a hotspot from memory.
  • 🕵️ Forensic Analytics: See exactly where students clicked incorrectly. Identify common misconceptions with heatmaps.
  • 🏅 Leaderboards: Gamify your classroom with top score lists.
  • 🎓 LMS Integration: Native support for LearnDash, LifterLMS, and TutorLMS.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ts-hotspot-quiz/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to TS Hotspot Quiz > Add New to create your first quiz.
  4. Copy the shortcode (e.g., [ts_visual_quiz id="5"]) and paste it into any Post or Page.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin compatible with my theme?

Yes, TS Hotspot Quiz is designed to work with any standard WordPress theme. The quizzes are responsive and adapt to your content container width.

Can I use this for Geography maps?

Absolutely. Upload a map image, set hotspots on cities or countries, and have students match the names to the locations.

Does the Free version save student results?

The Free version provides instant feedback to the student (Pass/Fail score). To save detailed attempts, view historical data, and analyze class performance, you will need the Pro version.
